run_discounted_cfr_solver: run discounted CFR solver on a game with configurable iterations and print frequency
create_DCFRSolver_instance: create a DCFRSolver instance from a pyspiel game object for solving imperfect information games
evaluate_and_update_policy: evaluate and update the policy iteratively using discounted CFR algorithm
get_average_policy: get the average policy from a DCFRSolver instance for exploitability evaluation
compute_exploitability: compute exploitability of a policy against optimal play using the exploitability function
